title: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses: Who Governs the Changes?
description: Thoughtworks put self-improving harnesses in Trial. An optimizer scored on benchmarks can delete a control you added on purpose. Keep the authority separate.
og_alt: Who Governs Self-Evolving Harnesses? Separating an optimizer's proposed harness edits from the authority to approve them.
